rules.title: Housing Stability Notification Act – Notice of Tenants' Rights and Resources
rules.requirement: Any Boston landlord planning to end your tenancy must give you a Notice of Tenants' Rights and Resources together with the Notice to Quit or non-renewal notice; if you didn't get it, report it to the Office of Fair Housing and Equity (617-635-2500 or 311). A violation does not stop the eviction process.
rules.key_value: Notice of Tenants' Rights and Resources with Notice to Quit; fine up to $300/day

coverage.summary: All landlords in Boston (and foreclosing owners for the city filing requirement) who plan to end a tenancy.

rules.penalty: 1st offense: warning; 2nd and subsequent offenses: $300 per day, enforced by Inspectional Services Department. Failure to submit Notice to Quit to the City may result in fine up to $300 per day. Violation does not halt the eviction process.
rules.citation: Boston City Code § 10-11.7 (Housing Stability Notification Act)
rules.quoted_span:
The Housing Stability Notification Act requires
ALL LANDLORDS
planning to end a tenancy agreement to provide the tenant with a Notice of Tenants’ Rights and Resources.
rules.conflict_note: Notice requirement only; Boston, MA has no just-cause eviction law.

notes: Official Boston.gov summary page of the Housing Stability Notification Act (Sec. 10-11.7). Only a notice requirement; no effective date stated. The landlord filing requirement with the City is part of the same rule and is folded into this record.
